split: Each scene: all sequence*/train/*/*.jpg for normal-only training; all sequence*/test/*/*.jpg for frame-level evaluation; paired .npy labels only in evaluation.
teacher: frozen DINOv3 ViT-B/16, 12 patch outputs L0..L11

evaluation.score: mean over 12 teacher-head top-5 patch cosine distances; larger means more anomalous
evaluation.metric: ROC AUC x100, all test frames concatenated within each scene; macro mean over seven scene AUCs
